attrs.author: Sentient
attrs.summary: Dobby-Unhinged-Llama-3.3-70B is the first ever Loyal model. It is owned and controlled by ~700,000 people, functions only in alignment with pro-freedom and pro-crypto values as the other Dobby models, all the while maintaining the strong general capabilities from Llama-3.3-70B. The Dobby models have their own unique personalities and are blunt, a bit rude, and often controversial. Given its AI friend tone and high performance marks, Dobby is prime to power anything from viral social and companion agents to utility chatbots with strong attitudes.
